_comment: One list for robots.txt AND sitemap.xml, so the two cannot disagree. `disallow` is written into robots.txt for every crawler and kept out of the sitemap. `sitemapExclude` is crawlable but not advertised (redirect stubs, the Play Store deletion page). `aiBots` are named in robots.txt so the policy toward them is explicit; they get exactly the same rules as everyone else. `indexNowKey` is public by design: IndexNow verifies it by fetching /<key>.txt.
